heading: Technology business ke liye honi chahiye. Business technology ke liye nahi.
paragraphs: ChoteBade started with one simple belief.
Most small businesses don't need complicated software. They need someone who actually understands how they work — and builds something around that, not the other way around.
Sometimes a better website is enough. Sometimes it's a simple booking system. Sometimes one small tool saves hours of manual work every week.
We start by understanding the business first. Then we figure out what technology can genuinely improve — nothing more, nothing less.
